role: The pumpkin and melon stems (ids 104 and 105): grow through 8 stages on random ticks, then place their fruit on farmland/dirt/grass beside them, and drop seeds when broken.

members.name: field_149877_a
members.note: the fruit block is rt_stem's fruit argument (RT_PUMPKIN / RT_MELON_BLOCK at the dispatch)

members.name: field_149876_b
members.note: the connected icon, drawn by the stem renderer

members.name: BlockStem
members.note: ids 104/105: Material.plants rows, 0.125 column bounds, tick_randomly, render_type 19

members.name: func_149854_a
members.note: the Crops-and-Stem override to farmland only, in blockcb.c's bush floor check

members.name: updateTick
members.note: the light-9 gate, the growth roll against growth_rate, the stage increment, and the fruit placement with its 4-direction roll

members.name: func_149875_n
members.note: the shared farmland-ring float loop (with BlockCrops.func_149864_n)

members.name: getRenderColor
members.note: the stage tint is client render; the stem renderer draws by stage

members.name: setBlockBoundsForItemRender
members.note: only RenderBlocks.renderBlockAsItem calls it (a block's item stack in a GUI, a hand, a dropped item or an enderman's hands); pumpkin and melon stems have no ItemBlock (Item.registerItems' exclusion set) and endermen do not carry them

members.name: func_149873_e
members.note: the fruit-direction check exists in the stem renderer (render_blocks3.c:765); the citation names the stem render function, verify the exact symbol; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames

members.name: dropBlockAsItemWithChance
members.note: case 104/105: 3 rolls of nextInt(15) <= fortune for the pumpkin/melon seeds; a pop spawns through randomtick.c:crop_drop (the null base item draws only its roll)

members.name: func_149872_i
members.note: the connected icon; the stem renderer builds the texture name directly (render_blocks3.c:57)

members.name: harvestBlock
members.note: inherited BlockBush body (no shears branch in vanilla for stems); covered by the BlockBush record's dispatch

notes: world-crops-s1 (2400 ticks of crop growth, DEVLOG 2026-09-25) is the world-tick check that covers stem growth; the render_blocks3.c citation for func_149873_e names the stem render area rather than a symbol I read, so treat it as approximate.
